A complete financial set, accounts, named wallets, collections, payments, conversions, and cross-border movement, embedded into your product as one unit. You offer it under your brand. Okoora runs it underneath. 200+ countries and 65 currencies, live from day one. Get Started okoora-api.js Who this is for If you have customers, you can offer them financial capabilities. Extend your offer You already serve your customers, and you want to add financial capabilities. Wallets, accounts, payments, and movement, built into what you already offer. Build from scratch You are building a financial offering for your customers from the ground up. The full set, ready to embed, without assembling it yourself. Banks, fintechs, loyalty programs, travel platforms, marketplaces, and any business with customers to serve. The problem with assembling A financial offering is many parts. Assembling them is the hard part. To give your customers accounts and money movement, you need an accounts provider, a payments provider, conversions, cross-border rails, and the regulation and compliance under all of it. Each from somewhere else. Each integrated, maintained, and held together by you. Whether you are adding to what you have or starting fresh, the same wall stands in the way. The capability is available. Stitching it into one offering, alone, is the work. That is where most financial offerings stall, before they ever reach a customer. The complete set One complete financial set, ready to embed. Not parts from separate providers, stitched together by you. One set, built to work together, embedded into your product as a single unit. Accounts and named wallets. Multi-currency accounts and named sub-wallets your customers recognize as their own, under your brand. Collections and payments. Your customers collect and pay across borders, on local rails where they exist, worldwide everywhere else. Conversions and movement. Currency conversion and money movement between accounts and entities, built in. You do not build the financial infrastructure. It is already built. You embed it, and it works as one. One capability. Two ways to run it. Operate it in your own business → Embed it for your customers → One capability. Two ways to run it. Operate it in your own business → Embed it for your customers → Give your customers a financial offering. Without building one. A complete set, accounts, wallets, payments, conversions, and movement, embedded under your brand, on regulated infrastructure, ready to run. You bring the customers. Okoora brings the financial set. Multi-currency accounts, named sub-wallets, collections, cross-border payments, FX conversions, and money movement, all built to work together. Available across 200+ countries and 65 currencies from a single integration. Do we need to become a regulated entity to offer financial services? No. Okoora operates as the regulated infrastructure underneath your product. Your customers see your brand. The compliance, custody, and regulatory weight stay with Okoora. You embed the set and configure the experience. Okoora's team runs alongside yours for onboarding, configuration, and compliance sign-off. The set is designed for any business that serves customers and wants to offer financial capabilities, not only fintechs. Loyalty programs, travel platforms, marketplaces, and non-financial brands all use it, because the requirement (customers who move money) is the same across all of them. Give them conversions, protection, and hedging under your brand, and turn FX that already runs around them into a revenue line you own. Institutional-grade FX, embedded, with no trading desk to build. Get Started The opportunity FX is already all around your customers. Right now, someone else holds it. Every customer who pays a supplier abroad, sells across borders, or holds more than one currency is exposed to FX, all the time. Today they handle it somewhere else, or they do not handle it at all. Every one of those moments is a product you could be offering, and a revenue line you have not opened. The activity is already there. The only question is whether your customers get it from you. Offer it, and the same customers become a new source of FX revenue. The product set Institutional FX, in language your customers understand. The full range of FX products, from the simple to the sophisticated, ready to embed under your brand. Your customers get institutional-grade capability. You offer it as your own. Currency conversions. Convert between currencies at institutional rates, built directly into your product. Currency protection. Let your customers lock a rate and protect value against market moves. jobs.title: AI pricing per client and transaction
jobs.description: AI Pricing Per Client and Per Transaction | Okoora AI Pricing Price every client right, win every deal, keep every margin. Your customers run conversions, payments, and cross-border activity every day. Okoora's AI prices each one live, per client and per transaction, inside the limits you set, so you win the deal at the highest margin it holds, and leave nothing on the floor. $30M in new revenue, one client, in two years. Get Started Who this is for If your customers move money, this is about your margin. Already pricing. You already offer financial services to your customers. Conversions, payments, cross-border. Are you sure every one is priced right? Adding services now. You are building wallets, accounts, and money movement for your customers. The infrastructure is the easy part. How will you know what to charge? The problem with flat pricing Why a fixed margin always loses. A fixed margin is one number against a market that is never one number. You set a margin once, and it prices every client and every deal the same. But no two clients are the same, and the market moves by the second. Set it high, and the deal you could have won goes elsewhere. Set it low, and the deal closes, with revenue you could have kept left behind. One number cannot be right for both. So it loses one of them, on every transaction. The engine Only intelligence can find the right price. The highest price a client will accept, on this transaction, in this market, this second, is not something you can set in advance. It changes with the client, the size, the moment, and the market. A fixed rule is just a fixed margin wearing a smarter name. Okoora's AI makes the decision live, on every transaction, the way a seasoned pricing desk would, at a scale no desk could reach. You set the boundaries. Your floors, your limits, your pricing logic. The lines it operates within. The AI finds the point. The highest margin that still wins the deal, per client, per transaction, in real time. You stay in control. The intelligence decides inside your limits, never outside them. This intelligence was written by people who operated finance for over twenty years, then built onto advanced AI. That is why it prices the way an expert prices, and why a rules table never will. The commercial move Anyone can give your customers a wallet. The revenue is in how you price it. Wallets, accounts, payments, conversions. Many providers offer them, and your customers can get them from anyone. The infrastructure moves the money. It does not tell you what to charge to make money on it. The moment you offer financial services under your brand, that is the question that decides whether they pay off: priced right, they are a revenue engine. Priced by a flat guess, they are a cost you carry. The pricing engine is what turns embedded financial services from a feature you offer into revenue you run. The embed model It runs inside your platform, under your brand. You build nothing. Okoora's pricing engine embeds beneath your product and runs in the background. Your customers see your brand and your prices. Okoora prices every transaction underneath, live, inside the limits you set. The full mechanism that prices each transaction lives in the intelligence layer. Price Every Transaction The Proof Priced live. Proven in production. $30M New revenue, one client, two years. Same customers, priced right. Live Across global banks, fintechs, and enterprises today. The same volume, priced by the engine instead of a flat margin, is where that new revenue came from. Not new customers. The customers you already have, priced right. See every deal priced live, inside your limits. Okoora's AI prices each client and each transaction in the moment, inside the boundaries you set, so you win the deal at the highest margin it holds, and capture the full revenue your customer volume can produce. Get Started Already pricing your customers: see how much more the same volume can produce. | Adding financial services: get the engine that makes them pay from day one. Recognition Recognized by Common questions AI pricing, answered. How is AI pricing different from a rules-based margin table? A rules table sets a fixed answer in advance for a class of transaction. AI pricing makes a live decision for each transaction, in the moment, using the client profile, the transaction size, and the current market. The rule cannot adapt. The AI does, every time. Do we keep control of the pricing limits? Yes. You set the floors, ceilings, and any segment-level constraints. The AI operates inside those boundaries, always. It finds the optimal point within the space you defined, and never moves outside it. Can we set different pricing policies for different customer segments? Yes. You configure pricing logic by client segment, volume tier, currency pair, product type, or any combination. The engine applies your configured policy to every transaction in that segment, in real time. Where does the $30M figure come from? It is a verified client result: one platform that moved the same transaction volume through the AI pricing engine instead of a flat margin, and captured $30M in new revenue over two years. The customers did not change. The pricing did. How does the pricing engine embed into our product? Via API. Your customers see your product and your prices. Okoora prices every transaction in the background, inside the limits you set, and returns the result before the transaction completes. The mechanism is invisible to your customers. © 2026 Okoora | All Rights Reserved Privacy policy Cookie Policy Legal Supported Currencies Whistleblowing Glossary
